scope: #585 / #451 incremental empty-video surfaces, not general media-state support
contract: preserve the actual visible styled video box when HAVE_NOTHING and no poster; do not draw an unavailable frame or invent a poster
rootCause: currentSrc means media selection, not decoded image availability. Zero intrinsic dimensions produce canvas data:, which cannot be loaded as an image. No-poster empty surfaces have no media pixels to rasterize. An element without a selected resource instead tries to load an empty poster URL; that is also not a media image.
fix: use the default transparent canvas image for this unambiguous state; normal frame and poster branches remain unchanged
